title: Saigon markets
sub: Electronics first, then fabric, tailors and clothes, Nov 2026
tip: Bargain everywhere except chain shops; start at about half. Test gadgets in front of the seller and ask for a receipt or warranty (bảo hành). For a new phone or laptop with a proper guarantee, use a chain shop like Thế Giới Di Động or CellphoneS instead. Markets open early and wind down by about 6pm. Mind your phone in the crowds.

home.name: Wink Hotel Saigon Centre
home.addr: 75 Nguyễn Bỉnh Khiêm, Đa Kao, District 1

places.name: Chợ Nhật Tảo (electronics, parts, second-hand gadgets)
notes: Saigon's big electronics market: used phones, cameras and lenses, speakers, chargers, cables, LED strips, repair tools
Mix of new parts and second-hand kit; quality varies, so test before you pay
Go in daytime; most stalls are shut by evening

places.name: Chợ Dân Sinh (tools, hardware, electrical bits, army surplus)
notes: Old-school market for tools, wire, plugs, adapters and hardware
Famous for army-surplus stalls: boots, bags, jackets
Near Ben Thanh, so pair it with Hà Tâm for USD

places.name: Tân Định Market (fabric & tailors)
notes: Closest to Wink: fabric and sewing stalls, with tailors next door to make it up
Cheaper fabric shops line Hai Bà Trưng opposite
Local prices, much less touristy than Ben Thanh
places.addr: Hai Bà Trưng × Nguyễn Hữu Cầu, Tân Định

places.name: Saigon Square (clothes, bags, shoes, accessories)
notes: Air-conditioned arcade of small stalls: cheap clothes, backpacks, shoes, sunglasses, phone cases

places.name: Bến Thành Market (souvenirs, fabric, quick tailors, food)
notes: The famous one: tailors will run up shirts and áo dài fast
Most expensive of the lot, so bargain hard or just browse and eat
places.addr: Lê Lợi × Phan Bội Châu, District 1

places.name: An Đông Market (clothes, fabric & áo dài tailors)
notes: Fashion and fabric hub, cheaper and bigger choice than Ben Thanh
Some tailors here turn an áo dài round quickly
Pin is the middle of An Đông ward; Directions finds the market

places.name: Bình Tây Market (wholesale everything, Chợ Lớn)
notes: Chinatown's big wholesale market: fabric, clothes, household goods, dried food
Busy, real and great to wander; the clock-tower building is lovely
Furthest out, so make it a half-day with Chợ Lớn's temples
